page_title: ESP 1-0 ELC | Espanyol v Elche 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+1' Alvaro Nunez (Elche) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Josan (Elche) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
89' Andre Silva (Elche) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
88' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) lunges into his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
87' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
85' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
85' Inaki Pena (Elche) sends an accurate short pass. Adria Pedrosa controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
84' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:2.
82' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) replaces Pere Milla.
79' Victor Chust (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pedro Bigas.
79' Pere Milla (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Ricardo De Burgos and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
78' The Elche players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
75' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Exposito is replaced by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol).
75' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Carlos Romero (Espanyol) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jose Salinas.
74' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Inaki Pena was alert and made a comfortable save.
72' Elche take a short corner kick.
72' Elche are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
70' Substitution. German Valera makes way for Josan (Elche).
70' Here is a change. Marc Aguado is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche).
68' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Inaki Pena, who smothers the ball.
65' Jofre goes off the pitch and Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) comes on.
64' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ricardo De Burgos ignores the protests.
64' Ricardo De Burgos interrupts the game. One of the players from Elche won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
63' Inaki Pena displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jofre (Espanyol) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
60' Elche are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
56' Substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) has come on for Martim Neto.
56' Eder Sarabia decides to make a substitution. Leo Petrot will be replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
54' Elche take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Exposito (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
51' Espanyol are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Exposito tees up Carlos Romero (Espanyol) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:0.
46' Elche couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
46' Half-time substitution. Manolo Gonzalez decided to make a change. Clemens Riedel is replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Espanyol get a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
39' Rafa Mir (Elche) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
38' German Valera (Elche) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
34' Espanyol are seeing far more of the ball now.
33' The ball goes out for a corner. Espanyol can continue in their attacking effort.

32' Pere Milla (Espanyol) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him. Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Elche.
27' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.

26' The game is pretty dull as Elche are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Espanyol.
25' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 30:70.
24' Neat passing move from Espanyol in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

22' Inaki Pena pulls off a great save to deny Pere Milla (Espanyol) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The referee points to the corner flag and Espanyol will take a corner.
20' A player from Elche commits a rough challenge. Ricardo De Burgos blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
15' Espanyol enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' Elche are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
11' Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
11' A great solo run by Rafa Mir (Elche) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Marko Dmitrovic.
11' The Elche players are exchanging some short passes.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Elche.
4' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Espanyol have a corner.

1' Jofre (Espanyol) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top right corner. Inaki Pena is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Espanyol earn a corner.
